title: Rameses II marries a daughter of Cyaxares
summary: CFAH identifies the Hittite princess married by Rameses II as a daughter of the Median king Cyaxares.
description: CFAH identifies the Hittite princess married by Rameses II as a daughter of the Median king Cyaxares. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 610 BC (AP-74, OSF preprint CFAH-9)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-9: The 19th and 26th Dynasties of Egypt," OSF preprint v1.4 (25 Sep 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/HV3B2, file CFAH-9_Dynasties_19_and_26_v1.4.pdf, p. 30, section "AP-74: Marriage of Rameses II to Daughter of Cyaxares, 610 BC"
